title: Unifies the exhibit number input by the user
goal: uses trim and toUpperCase to normalize strings.
summary: tag number is entered manually. Ignore the leading and trailing spaces, make the letters uniformly uppercase, and retain the original characters in the middle of the number.
tasks: completes normalizeTag(tag), removes leading and trailing spaces, and converts letters to uppercase.
retains hyphens, numbers, and intervening spaces. Pure whitespace returns the empty string.

example.note: string method returns a new string, and the methods can be called together.

hint: trim() only processes both ends of the string and does not delete the content inside the number.
